title: Country of Origin Certificate for LM358DT
content:
Hello Sir

I’d like to know your goods label rules.

it’s only have Assemble country information, no Wafer production country information? 

here’s my stock label information. and now i have a new batch need impoted and the documents was wrote COO is Morocco.

the Customs asked us provide the Country of Origin Certificate.

could you please support ?

scraped_replies.html:
Welcome ​@AliceZzzzz, to the community!

STMicroelectronics has two different kinds of support and enquiries:

  1. personal support through OLS, the Online Support team
  2. mutual help between users worldwide via the community

As the users worldwide also do not have the information you are looking for, only personal support through OLS can help you further.

Hope that helps?

Regards
/Peter
